name: Hisham Al Ayass
title: Senior broadcast journalist and financial media specialist
bio_short: Senior broadcast journalist and financial media specialist. Former Head of Business News at Qatar TV. One of the most respected news anchors in Arabic business television. Specialist in financial and business media training. Based in Doha.
bio: Hisham is a senior broadcast journalist and financial media specialist recognised across the Middle East as one of the most respected news anchors in Arabic business television. As Head of Business News at Qatar TV, he established a new business news division and led a team of reporters and producers covering a wide range of financial, trade, energy, real estate and technology stories across the GCC and beyond.  His broadcasting career has spanned more than 20 years across major Arabic-language channels. He is a regular presence at international business events and conferences, and his interview experience with ministers, central bank governors, CEOs and financial regulators gives him a deep understanding of how business spokespeople perform in Arabic media.  At ISOC, Hisham delivers Arabic-language media training with a particular focus on financial and business media. He prepares executives and spokespeople for interviews with Arabic business press, conference presentations and investor communications. His experience building and running a business news operation means he understands not just the interview itself but the editorial context, the production pressures on journalists and what makes a spokesperson credible and quotable. Hisham is based in Doha and trains in Arabic and English.
